svg.title: Step 4 polish 02: the cue editor at 1280 px
svg.text: 02 · The cue editor (desktop, 1280 px)
One cue, as a two-card form on the content grid. Book shot O10 (and the library players of O9).

g.text: Something new plays at 80 %, waits behind urgent, results and attention, and is
One is picked at random, never the same twice running
Plays right after the sound; counts once in the budget.
Heard at 64 %: master 80 % × Something new 80 % × this cue 100 %.
If a moment is missed (a screen was off), it may still
Each tournament sounds it once, within 7 days.
Picked at random, never twice running.
The chosen effect plays here: ripple, 0.3 s, then the glow holds.
“Here” plays in this browser; a zone plays it
silently unless its sound is on.
Changed here: Drum roll added, picture holds 2

svg.text: What changed and why
A form on the grid
O10 stacked full-width boxes in one column
with labels jammed together ("Once per source
(7 days) Level %"). Now two cards on the
content grid: Sound on the left, Picture and
Try it on the right; each label sits on its
own line above its control.
Category as chips, with its meaning
The category is one chip of six, and the line
below says what it means in plain words
(level, who it waits for, calm). O10 had a
dropdown.
Sounds as themed players
The chosen sounds are players in the theme
with play and stop, a waveform and the
length; × removes one. The rest of the
library is one tap away as chips. O10 had a
wrapped line of small checkboxes; O9 had the
browser’s light-grey players.
Level as a slider, with what you hear
A slider in steps of 5 %, and one line that
multiplies it out: master × category × cue.
Times as sliders and steppers
Not again for is a slider with named stops
(Off to 10 min); catch-up is a stepper in
minutes; once per source is a switch. No
typed seconds.
Picture effects as chips, with a preview
Effects are chips; Holds for is a slider; the
small virtual screen plays the chosen effect.
Try it, then save
Try it plays the cue here or on a zone. Save
and Cancel sit in a pending row; Reset to
default moves into the card that says what
changed from the pack.
